notes: A fixed slingshot firing at a crocodile circling a small lake is a target gallery, and the genre notes put a gallery on Aim Trainer / range-directed rather than P5: one firing line, everything the player aims at in front of it, safe ground behind. The answers confirm one player rooted at the slingshot with the lake sized for a one-second lob, so nobody walks the space and Stage B appends SET to the P0 build. Party & Casual is named second for the 60-second round wrapper, which is where trigger-scoring comes from; no lobby, leaderboard wall or spectator area exists in this game so none of its other options apply, and I dropped Aim Trainer's station-loadout since there is one slingshot that reloads itself. Decided without a user: the lake is a flat scenic barrier nobody swims, so water-body raises no CHECK, and the menu, badge library, timer and gamepass-style saving are all GUI with no layout footprint.
